description: Raw material ingredients are weighed and dosed into the mixing vessel for batch preparation.
Ingredients are blended at controlled speed and torque to achieve uniform cookie dough consistency.
Dough is shaped into individual cookie portions using rotary molder or wire-cut forming equipment.
Formed cookies are conveyed through tunnel ovens at controlled temperature, airflow, and burner load profiles.
Baked cookies are cooled on a cooling conveyor table to achieve the target exit temperature before packaging.
Cooled cookies are individually or multi-pack flow-wrapped and sealed using the packaging line wrapper.
Wrapped cookie packs are quality-checked, case-packed, and palletized for warehouse storage and dispatch.
